cases.title: A deeply nested pattern that re.compile rejects never raises out of judge

seeds.title: judge: first failing rule without a label is overwritten by the next failing rule
seeds.detail: judge uses 'failed is None' to detect the first failure. A failing rule with no label stores None, so a later failing rule replaces it. A forge rule always has a label, so this is low risk.

seeds.title: judge and ref_format_error raise Fail or TypeError for NUL, lone surrogate and non-string samples
seeds.detail: NUL and lone surrogate raise Fail ('embedded null byte', a utf-8 encode error). None, int, list, dict, bool and float raise TypeError. Callers pass strings built from a validated format, so this is low risk. A NUL sample could give a fail verdict instead.

seeds.title: judge: a rule with a missing kind gets the note 'unknown kind None'
seeds.detail: The note is accurate but unhelpful. Low risk.
